datasets.name: kpis
datasets.query: SELECT *, ROUND(total_cost / 1e9, 2) AS total_cost_bn FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview

datasets.name: utilization
datasets.query:
SELECT * FROM workspace.gold.agg_monthly_utilization
WHERE month_start >= add_months((SELECT snapshot_date FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview), -120)
  AND month_start < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT snapshot_date FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview))

datasets.name: readmissions
datasets.query:
SELECT * FROM workspace.gold.agg_readmission_monthly
WHERE discharge_month >= add_months((SELECT snapshot_date FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview), -120)
  AND discharge_month < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT snapshot_date FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview))

datasets.name: demographics
datasets.query:
SELECT gender, age_band, COUNT(*) AS patients
FROM workspace.gold.dim_patient WHERE NOT is_deceased GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: prevalence_overall
datasets.query:
SELECT condition_group,
  SUM(patients_with_condition) AS patients_with_condition,
  ROUND(SUM(patients_with_condition) / (SELECT living_patients FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview), 4) AS prevalence_rate
FROM workspace.gold.agg_chronic_prevalence GROUP BY condition_group

datasets.name: prevalence_age
datasets.query:
WITH pop AS (
  SELECT age_band, COUNT(*) AS living FROM workspace.gold.dim_patient WHERE NOT is_deceased GROUP BY age_band)
SELECT c.condition_group, c.age_band, ROUND(SUM(c.patients_with_condition) / MAX(pop.living), 4) AS prevalence_rate
FROM workspace.gold.agg_chronic_prevalence c JOIN pop USING (age_band)
WHERE c.condition_group IN ('Hypertension', 'Diabetes', 'Prediabetes', 'Obesity', 'Coronary heart disease', 'COPD')
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: organizations
datasets.query:
SELECT organization_name, city, inpatient_admissions, avg_length_of_stay_days,
  readmission_rate_30d, encounters, total_cost
FROM workspace.gold.agg_organization_performance
WHERE inpatient_admissions >= 50
ORDER BY readmission_rate_30d DESC

datasets.name: payer_split
datasets.query:
SELECT payer_type, 'Paid by insurer' AS component, SUM(payer_paid) AS amount
FROM workspace.gold.agg_payer_performance WHERE year = (SELECT YEAR(snapshot_date) FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview) - 1 GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT payer_type, 'Paid by patient', SUM(patient_out_of_pocket)
FROM workspace.gold.agg_payer_performance WHERE year = (SELECT YEAR(snapshot_date) FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview) - 1 GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: payer_coverage
datasets.query:
SELECT payer_name, payer_type, coverage_rate, patients_served
FROM workspace.gold.agg_payer_performance WHERE year = (SELECT YEAR(snapshot_date) FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview) - 1

datasets.name: oop_trend
datasets.query:
SELECT MAKE_DATE(year, 1, 1) AS year_start, payer_type, SUM(patient_out_of_pocket) AS patient_out_of_pocket
FROM workspace.gold.agg_payer_performance WHERE year BETWEEN (SELECT YEAR(snapshot_date) FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview) - 10 AND (SELECT YEAR(snapshot_date) FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview) - 1 GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: top_meds
datasets.query:
SELECT medication_description, SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost, SUM(patients) AS patients
FROM workspace.gold.agg_top_medications WHERE year BETWEEN (SELECT YEAR(snapshot_date) FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview) - 10 AND (SELECT YEAR(snapshot_date) FROM workspace.gold.kpi_overview) - 1
GROUP BY medication_description ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: dq
datasets.query:
SELECT table_name, check_name, severity, failed_rows, total_rows, status
FROM workspace.silver.dq_results
WHERE run_ts = (SELECT MAX(run_ts) FROM workspace.silver.dq_results)
